notes: Plan 5.1 1B -> 8B option (b) (recommended): a PRETRAINED open LLM of similar size is the State Encoder through an adapter (as Microsoft did with Qwen3.5-9B); its attention is converted to bidirectional with a short masked-token adaptation phase, and the workspace, set layer, readouts and Checker are trained from scratch on top. This needs a pretrained backbone (adapter_backbone, a local path) and the v1 rhen/adapter.py as the starting point. The trainer raises NotImplementedError for this stage; the config exists so the required keys are fixed. Option (a), training the 8B from scratch, needs roughly a trillion pretraining tokens and is a compute decision, not a config change.
